title: CSS Outline Width
text:
CSS
Outline Width



CSS Outline Width

The
outline-width
property specifies the width of the outline,
and can have one of the following values:

thin
(typically 1px)

medium
(typically 3px)

thick
(typically 5px)

A specific size (in px, pt, cm, em, etc)
